name: Hotel Bogner
beschreibung: The Hotel Bogner is a four-star hotel in Absam at the foot of the Karwendelgebirge. The quiet location at the entrance to the Halltal shapes the surroundings of the house. The rooms are functionally furnished and offer views of the surrounding mountain landscape. The hotel's wellness area includes a sauna and a steam bath. The gastronomy focuses on regional Tiroler Küche. In summer, the hotel is a starting point for hikes, in winter for ski trips to the nearby Glungezer Bergbahnen. The center of Absam with the Basilika St. Michael is reachable on foot. Guests can expect accommodation here with a direct connection to nature and the infrastructure of the region.
